panels.title: Delivery Order Arrives
panels.speechBubble: I received today's delivery order! Time to sort the packages.
panels.narration: The automated sorting robot scans arriving packages at the central warehouse loading dock.

panels.title: Scanning Package Weights
panels.speechBubble: Box A weighs 10 kilograms. Box B weighs 5 kilograms.
panels.narration: The robot measures both boxes on the digital scale and prepares to place them on the delivery cart.

panels.title: Unexpected Total Displayed
panels.speechBubble: Total weight displayed: 105 kilograms! That looks way too heavy!
panels.narration: The scale readout screen flashes 105 kilograms instead of the expected combined weight.

panels.title: Cart Overloaded
panels.speechBubble: Stop! The robot loaded extra heavy weights onto the cart!
panels.narration: The delivery cart tilts under the heavy load as staff gather to investigate the scale readout.

panels.title: Track Setup
panels.speechBubble: Welcome to the mini electric car championship! Position your cars.
panels.narration: Two children place their electric toy cars at the starting line of the wooden track.

panels.title: Race Commences
panels.speechBubble: Green light! Red Car completes in 8 seconds. Blue Car in 12 seconds.
panels.narration: Both cars zoom down the straight track toward the automatic infrared finish gate.

panels.title: Scoreboard Announcement
panels.speechBubble: Winner announced on the big screen: Blue Car wins the trophy!
panels.narration: The digital scoreboard displays Blue Car as winner despite its higher finish time.

panels.title: Confused Runners
panels.speechBubble: Wait! I crossed the line first with a lower time score!
panels.narration: The crowd points at the scoreboard while the judge double checks the timing log.

panels.title: Morning Attendance
panels.speechBubble: Good morning Class 4! Please submit your math worksheets.
panels.narration: Students place their completed homework sheets into the digital scanner basket.

panels.title: Scanning Worksheets
panels.speechBubble: Ananya scored 90 marks. Rohan scored 85 marks.
panels.narration: The monitor inputs student names and scores into the digital attendance register.

panels.title: Mismatched Records
panels.speechBubble: Look at the screen! Rohan's report shows Ananya's score!
panels.narration: The digital portal swaps student names and marks on the class projection screen.

panels.title: Classroom Surprise
panels.speechBubble: My grade report has someone else's name at the top!
panels.narration: Students hold their printed grade sheets in confusion as the teacher halts distribution.

panels.title: Station Departure
panels.speechBubble: Express Train 101 departing Platform 3 for Central City!
panels.narration: Passengers board the silver passenger train while staff verify digital ticket passes.

panels.title: Checking Passports
panels.speechBubble: Checking tickets for Coach A, Coach B, and Coach C.
panels.narration: The conductor scans barcode tickets for passengers across three separate seating coaches.

panels.title: Intermediary Stop
panels.speechBubble: Passing Riverton station! All signals show green status.
panels.narration: The train maintains steady speed along the scenic countryside rail line.

panels.title: Seat Count Anomaly
panels.speechBubble: The display says 50 passengers boarded, but 120 seats are occupied!
panels.narration: The conductor counts 120 passengers in seats while the hand scanner reads only 50.

panels.title: Coach Lock
panels.speechBubble: Coach C passengers were completely skipped by the counter!
panels.narration: Staff discover that one coach scanner failed to send data to the main log.

panels.title: Clinic Check-up
panels.speechBubble: Welcome to the health clinic! Let's record today's vitals.
panels.narration: Patients wait comfortably in the bright clinic reception as health check-ups begin.

panels.title: Measuring Temperature
panels.speechBubble: Patient 1 temp is 37°C. Patient 2 temp is 36.5°C. Patient 3 is 37.2°C.
panels.narration: The nurse measures patient temperatures using the digital smart thermometer.

panels.title: Calculating Average
panels.speechBubble: Running the automated clinic average calculation for today's visits.
panels.narration: The monitor computes summary vitals for the morning patient logs.

panels.title: Alarm Triggers
panels.speechBubble: Wait! The screen shows average clinic temperature is 110.7°C!
panels.narration: Red warning lights flash on the console as an impossible average temperature displays.

panels.title: Formula Investigation
panels.speechBubble: The total sum was displayed instead of dividing by patient count!
panels.narration: The medical team pauses testing to inspect the health dashboard readout.

panels.title: Shift Begins
panels.speechBubble: Smart Factory Line 4 online! Target output: 100 sealed solar lights.
panels.narration: Robotic arms and automated conveyor belts light up in the high-tech solar factory.

panels.title: Assembly Progress
panels.speechBubble: Solar cells mounted. Casing inspect sensor active on belt 1.
panels.narration: Products move smoothly through assembly, testing, and quality control stations.

panels.title: Quality Sensor Check
panels.speechBubble: Pass mark set at 80 points. Checking unit 42 with 85 points.
panels.narration: The optical scanner measures solar panel output voltage against minimum requirements.

panels.title: Reject Bin Overflow
panels.speechBubble: Warning! Unit 42 passed quality check but was thrown into the reject bin!
panels.narration: The sorting lever diverts high-scoring units into the scrap container.

panels.title: Multiple System Events
panels.speechBubble: Accept bin has 0 items! Reject bin has all 100 perfect units!
panels.narration: Every single quality-checked solar light ends up in the rejected items bin.

panels.title: Investigation Opened
panels.speechBubble: Multiple events occurred here. Examine the sorting logic to solve the case!
panels.narration: The factory manager halts line 4 as detective team opens the case investigation.
